scope: Near-range stucco grain and world-space weathering on the three plaster wall materials of environment.glb. JSON-only GLB edit (BIN byte-exact) plus one shared detail map; runtime onBeforeCompile patch in src/scripts/games/cs/plaster-detail.ts. No geometry, UV, collision, lighting or other-material changes.
source_cache: art-factory/cs/runs/run-20261010-v37-plaster-detail/raw/polyhaven-white_stucco_02/ (md5 asserted against the Poly Haven files API by the cook)

postprocess.steps: Whole 2k scan Lanczos to 1024 (no crop, stays seamless); wrap-around Gaussian high-pass sigma 48 on normal XY and luminance; pack R = AO x luminance high-pass cavity, GB = high-passed normal XY x1.6; JPEG q76 4:4:4 mozjpeg.
postprocess.procedural: Macro brightness/hue variation, rotated second base-map read (anti-tiling), rising-damp grime by world height and rain streaks are computed in the shader from world position; no painted pixels.

gates: Pinned CC0 source with md5 matching the Poly Haven API
BIN chunk byte-exact; only the three plaster materials, one image/texture/sampler and extensionsUsed differ (asserted by the cook)
Shader patch unit tests (anchors present, one detail fetch, grime by world height, validator ranges)
Asset tests: shared sealed detail, valid extras, no extra mesh/primitive, bundle <= 34 MB
Same-camera real-renderer captures near 0.6 m / base 1 m / mid 5 m / street at high and low quality; draw calls identical
Published native capture equals candidate capture (low pixel-identical, high <= 2.2 mean diff from SSAO/shadow noise)

rejected.a-stucco1k: JPEG q88 917 KB exceeded the +0.8 MB allowance
rejected.b-stucco1k-q76: Cavity albedo 0.55 read as dark pepper speckles at 0.6 m
rejected.c-tuned: Macro variation and grime invisible at street distance (value noise clustered near 0.5)

known_gaps: Grime is height-only (no per-building ground, sill or roof-edge awareness); streaks are noise columns not tied to sills; no decals, edge wear, plaster patches or chipped corners; shaded walls show grain only weakly; base trim/stone/dome materials unchanged.
